messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Separate processes in different tabs
parts:
Hello, 

Is there a way to separate processes in different tabs?  What I mean is this: You have a Shiny app with say two tabs. The data processed and displayed in each tab are separate - they don't depend on each other. However, at least the way mine is setup (here: https://github.com/ropensci/usgs_app) when entering the page, or reloading with new data, all processing has to be done before any tab can display their output. 

It would be great if tab A could process its data, and present results when the user is on tab A, and it isn't slowed down by what's going on in tab B. 

Thanks! Scott

I have tried using reactivePlot/reactiveTable/etc. to separate each action, but I always get an error like

I'm obviously doing something wrong when trying to use reactivePlot/reactiveTable/etc. instead of renderPlot/renderTable/etc.

Thanks! Scott
